### Drafting requirement

Write connected prose of **at most 150 words**, including finding, action/condition, important limit and next evidence/purpose. Put **source references on a separate line outside the word limit**.

Count whitespace-separated words in the brief body, including headings/labels if you use them there. A correct word count or matching number does not establish faithful interpretation. Different bounded actions can be defensible.

<p class="caption">F1-F4 are the drafting evidence. D11 is a hypothetical decision scenario, not an empirical finding or a verified budget. The proposed 1,800 AED allowance does not establish full cost or total national spending.</p>
